reason: A governance plugin for agent workflows that evaluates every pre-execution tool call through TapPass and can allow, deny, or route calls for approval, with an observe mode for recording decisions.

summaries.zh: 通过 TapPass 策略服务评估智能体的每次工具调用，并支持放行、拒绝或转交人工审批。
summaries.en: Evaluates each agent tool call through the TapPass policy service and supports allowing, denying, or routing calls for human approval.

capabilities: intercepts agent tool calls before execution
sends tool-call data to the TapPass /v1/govern API
allows or denies tool execution based on policy verdicts
routes approval-required calls to a human approval flow
records observed policy decisions and tool-call activity
